title: tests/test_crash.py fails for 'v2 init' stopped by SIGKILL and SIGINT: a leftover todo/.tadu.json temporary is reported
result: tests/test_crash.py fails for 'v2 init' stopped by SIGKILL and SIGINT: a leftover todo/.tadu.json temporary is reported
evidence: Root cause: run_task_init called run_sync before todo/tadu.json existed, so a format 2 init wrote the format 1 rule block and a rerun rewrote AGENTS.md. run_sync now takes task_backlog. uv run pytest -q -k crash -m 'not browser': 61 passed; -k 'sync or init': 56 passed; ruff and mypy clean.
